arguments.prompt: a ceramic coffee mug on a wooden table, soft morning light

examples.description: Generate a square product backdrop to edit next.

description: [paid: $0.04] Generate an image from a text prompt (google/nano-banana-2-lite) sized for editing. Returns JSON {images:[{url, asset_key, download_url?, width, height}], price, next} plus a preview; images are stored in this workspace, never provider links, and a result with no download_url says why in download_url_unavailable. Refuses: VALIDATION_ERROR on an empty prompt (describe the image), SIMPLER_IMAGE_PROMPT_REFUSED names the label (sexual, minor, real_person or other_unsafe): rewrite the prompt without it, for example no real person's name or likeness; SIMPLER_IMAGE_PROMPT_CHECK_UNAVAILABLE (the safety check is down, nothing charged: retry later); SIMPLER_IMAGE_OUTPUT_FLAGGED (the output failed the content check and was refunded: change the prompt); SIMPLER_IMAGE_OUTPUT_SCAN_UNAVAILABLE (outputs cannot be checked right now, nothing charged: retry later), INSUFFICIENT_CREDITS (add credits). SIMPLER_EDIT_RESULT_UNDELIVERED means the charge was refunded: retry. NEXT: pass images[0].asset_key as image_asset_key to image.inpaint, image.upscale or image.style_transfer.

preview_format.description: Preview block after the JSON, at most 384px on the long edge and never charged: png, jpeg or none. Left out, a PNG result gets a png preview and a JPEG or WebP result a jpeg one. A result with no preview says why in preview_unavailable.

request_ref.description: Optional idempotency key (1-64 chars: letters, digits, . _ : -). Retrying with the same request_ref and the same arguments within 24 hours returns the first result at $0 with replayed: true; the same request_ref with different arguments is refused (SIMPLER_IMAGE_REQUEST_REF_CONFLICT), and so is a retry whose first result was deleted since (SIMPLER_IMAGE_REQUEST_REF_RESULT_DELETED): send a new request_ref to run it again.

name: image.generate_for_edit
